text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Dufferin Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the removal of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Dufferin Street.

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Dufferin Street, between a point 96 metres north of Bank Street and a point 5.5 metres further north.
